title: Islands and palette
brief: Layout 01 (classic stacked, the default mode) rebuilt as islands on a canvas, in three palettes with more identity than the generic starter.

artboards.title: Signal (warm amber)
artboards.tradeoff: Warm and recognizable; POST and unresolved-variable warnings share the same gold

artboards.title: Signal Slate (amber on cool slate)
artboards.tradeoff: Same brand as Signal on a cooler base; less warmth, more neutral

artboards.title: Copper (muted terracotta)
artboards.tradeoff: Calm and refined for long sessions; less punch on the Send action

artboards.title: Volt (acid lime)
artboards.tradeoff: Most distinctive and tool-like; lime brand is loud and pushes GET off green

artboards.title: Rose (coral-rose)
artboards.tradeoff: Warm without reading as a warning; brand sits near the danger reds
